Dana Ruiz
Senior Full-Stack Developer | dana.ruiz@example.com | github.com/danaruiz-dev

Summary
Full-stack engineer, six years building TypeScript products end to end. Happiest owning a slice from the Postgres schema up to the React screen, with a preference for boring, observable infrastructure.

Experience

Senior Full-Stack Developer - Harborline (remote), 2022-present
- Built the dispatch API in Node.js (Fastify) and TypeScript; 1.8M requests/day at p95 under 140 ms
- Moved billing off a legacy Rails monolith into Node.js services without downtime; retired 32k lines
- Designed the PostgreSQL schema and Prisma migrations for invoicing; the monthly run dropped from 35 minutes to 5
- Added GitHub Actions CI with Docker layer caching; build time halved

Full-Stack Developer - Lantern Rail (Lisbon), 2019-2022
- Shipped the React front end of a crew-scheduling tool used daily by 1,200 staff
- Built REST and GraphQL APIs in Node.js/Express over PostgreSQL
- Set up structured logging and alerting; median incident resolution fell from 90 to 35 minutes

Skills
TypeScript, Node.js (Fastify, Express), React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker, GitHub Actions, REST, GraphQL, Jest, AWS basics (ECS, RDS, S3)
jobText:
Fernway builds scheduling software for independent veterinary clinics. About 900 practices run their day on it. We are hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to own product areas end to end — from the Postgres schema to the screens clinic staff touch every hour.

Day to day
- Ship features across our TypeScript stack: Node.js services, React front-end, PostgreSQL
- Take an area from schema sketch to production on AWS (ECS, RDS)
- Keep the CI pipeline fast (GitHub Actions, Docker)
- Review pull requests and mentor two mid-level engineers

What we are looking for
- 5+ years shipping production web applications
- Strong TypeScript and Node.js (Express, Fastify or NestJS)
- React in depth: hooks, state management, performance profiling
- PostgreSQL beyond CRUD: schema design, query optimization, migrations
- Comfortable with Docker and CI/CD
- Writes clearly — the team is async and remote-first

Nice to have
- Prisma or another type-safe ORM
- Redis and a queue (SQS or RabbitMQ)
- Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool
- Observability: Grafana, Prometheus

Remote worldwide · EUR 70-90k · 30 days paid leave · hardware budget
